reviews.text: We can't say enough good things about the entire team.  We have had wonderful clinical and grooming services for our beloved boys!
Very good customer service they answered all my questions about my pet would highly recommend 👍

Such a great vet office! We bring all 3 of our babies here. First visits for each were free. I also have a very reactive dog and she is typically afraid of men. That said, she had zero issues with the male veterinarian. He was patient and gentle with her. We also recently had to bring our cat in for a sick visit and the staff was so amazing working with us on treatment options. Again, such a great office. Highly recommend!
Great doctor and staff !
They are all very friendly and professional my dog loves going there for his checkup and boosters

I appreciate the staff here very much.  They are no nonsense (the decor is utilitarian at best) but friendly and accommodating, don't suggest a bunch of extra services I don't want or need, and  pricing is very reasonable.  I have taken my large dogs here for a few years.  One who was very old very recently passed away after being diagnosed with probable Lymphoma.  Dr Pearson specifically did not suggest any expensive testing, life-saving measures, etc.  He simply prepared us that his time was short, and gave us the meds needed to make him comfortable.  I have four dogs - I appreciate being treated as a grieving pet parent, and not a potential financial windfall, more than I can express.
Dr. Pearson and his staff are excellent and thorough.  My little Lilah loves her vet.
Compassionate and understanding vet and staff.  Can't recommend them enough!

Everyone there was super sweet, friendly, and took care of my pup with so much care! My dog is usually a bit timid, but with everyone there helped his energy come out and he was happy to see them! They’ve completely transformed what used to be an anxious vet visit for my dog into a calm, welcoming, and friendly experience!
Great service, friendly and professional staff. I receive a response in a timely manner each time I reach out for assistance. It makes it worth the drive.

Super smooth experience bringing Akira in! Booking was a breeze, and the front desk staff was so friendly and professional. The doctor and techs were super welcoming, extremely knowledgeable, and took great care of us. Highly recommend!

We brought our 11month old Shepherd Pup who was ill after p/up from boarding. I called and they brought us in the same day. This was our first visit. The staff was very kind and engaging and Dr. Schweers was very thorough and spent the time explaining to use her illness and dispensed the meds at the facility. I had an excellent first impression of this facility and will now be a regular customer. A clinic who care who will take great care of your pet.  Many Thanks
My husband and I were impressed with the staff and Dr. Larry at My Pet’s Vet! We were recommended by a family member and very happy we’ve established our Rosie’s care with them!!

It was my first time at this clinic. The doctor and the staff were very professional and friendly. My pet usually has a lot of anxiety when she goes to the vet, but this experience was very comforting for her. Their wellness plans are very reasonable and inclusive. I highly recommend.

The veterinarian is so amazing! And his Assistant super amazing my cat does not go with anyone and absolutely fell in love with her. This says a lot I highly recommend. The best thing it’s  three minutes away. This is Coco Chanel ‘s new Vet.🖤

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We're always looking for ways to improve and would love the opportunity to learn more about your experience. Since we aren't able to identify your visit from your review, please feel free to contact our clinic at your convenience so we can better understand your concerns. 830-292-6080
Dr. Pearson great guy 👍
First time bringing my fur babies to My Pet’s Vet. Hanna is so great! We really appreciated her knowledge and kindness.
This is the second time I have see Dr. Pearson and I am still impressed how he takes time to answer questions.  Everyone is kind and professional.
Got my puppy a wellness checkup and required vaccines.  I also use the puppy salon onsight.

This vet is amazing!! He really knows his stuff and does not try to upsell you!! Also Meagan is wonderful!! She has my dog's room warm and ready as soon as we walked in the door!! Hassel free no waiting!! Highly recommend!!
Excellent service

Our first time visiting this location, since we moved, its more convenient coming here than the Huebner location. We had a great visit, the doctor, nurse and receptionist were all super friendly and attentive to my very skiddish dog, they made her feel welcome, answered all our questions, they were quick as well, seems the Huebner location is usually a lot more busy, so this location was better for our dog, with less people and dogs.   We will definitely be coming back here. Thank you My Pets Vet, y'all are always awesome!!

Great place to take your pet. We took in our 14 year old cat and they were awesome checking her out. The staff, from Dr. Peterson to Meghan to everyone else we came in contact with was wonderful and very professional as well as personable. Highly recommend "My Pet's Vet" on Wilderness Oak and 281.
Great experience! Staff is very friendly and accommodating. We have a nervous pup and they do a great job.

Excellent and affordable service!!! We also use their grooming services.  Can't beat the care and attention to detail that they provide.

Thank you!!!

I have been taking Hazelnut to Dr. Larry Pearson and his team at My Pet's Vet since April of 2025. Everyone is very professional and Dr. Pearson welcomes Hazelnut with enthusiasm every visit. She is a sassy one and he continues to be pleasant. He and his staff are sincere with their intentions and put forth care towards every animal.

This place is fantastic!! Dr Pearson and the vet techs answered all my questions (even the dumb ones) and made my pups first vet visit go very smoothly. They also offer an affordable monthly wellness payment plan that helps plan for costs!
This Veterinarian and staff is a very professional, very knowledgeable and courteous they took the time to calm my puppy down she was very nervous..
Easiest nail appointment ever! Our 11y/o pittie usually requires calming meds before getting her nails done. Sasha got it done without a single whimper!

First visit with this location and is way better than the Huebner location in my opinion.  My 2 boys where In and out, the  staff was extremely friendly and Shelby was amazing!!! I’ll be coming back to this location specifically!!
Thank you!
Sasha was a wonderful groomer!  Very thorough and sweet with our pup 💕 …
We absolutely love this Vet! Our boys Gator and Otter are so loved every time they have a visit! Megan and Shelby are INCREDIBLE!! Can’t recommend a place more!!

Friendly, prompt and professional they were able to take us in at our appointed time. They explained all the services that we needed and that we asked for very personable folks and they relaxed our puppy in order to get him treated very pleasant experience.

Friendly professional and prompt. They got us in at our scheduled appointment time. I walked thoroughly through all the requests that we had around the itching and his shots and what’s the best treatment. They were wonderful people to work with and our puppy is very happy. Very very personable people.

Dr Pearson, Ashley, Megan and the rest of the team here took such good care of my older pup before during and after his surgery. And have consistently checked in all the way through the healing process. Kind, knowledgeable, helpful and compassionate during the entire process! Gio and I are very grateful.
They took great care of my dog and have been wonderful to work with both on the boarding and vet sides. Will be back soon!

I came in with an emergency for my cat without any prior history or appointment, the staff got my cat back right away and within 20 min the doctor had already examined her and made recommendations that saved her life. I am extremely grateful not only for their quick service, but for the kindness and excellent customer service.

I switched to this office after multiple bad experiences with a different local office, and I could not be more grateful. I have a senior dog who is naturally needing more care, and Dr. Schweers has been so incredible. She is extremely intelligent, upfront and clear about everything, kind and patient, and never makes you feel like she’s forcing or selling you something (which was the opposite at the last vet). Glad to have my dog under her care.

We used the grooming side this week and it was definitely a disappointment. There was a miscommunication at drop off some how and my dog did not get a haircut just a slight trim around his face and sanitary area. I took their first appointment which was a month away and it was a waste of time and money. The dog also smelled. He looked clean though so I could tell his hair was cleaned I'm just not sure if it was a water rinse or what happened. Their vet side is amazing and staff are friendly so I thought I'd try the grooming side.

Rarely do I take the opportunity to leave a comment about a service or a business or perhaps even an individual. This time is certainly an exception. Dr Peirson and his team are truly special people. Excellence and above: Professional and proficient, they make you feel like you and your pet are the most important thing in the world because, You Are.

We arrived for the procedure on our pet.  Immediately she was tested like she was there own pet with care and concern.  Dr Pearson came out to tell us what to expect.  Dr called to tell us later that all went well and when we could pick her up. All we're so kind when we picked her up.  They called me next morning to see how she was doing.  Dr Pearson call the day after to make sure she was back to herself.  These people are all great.
Muffin loves coming to the Vet! Everyone is so friendly!!!!

My Pet’s Vet Wilderness Oaks provided exceptional care for my newly adopted dog. From the minute you walk through the door, staff is friendly and the vet. techs and Dr. provided the care needed to bring all vaccines up to date.
Then, I utilized their grooming service. Susie did an amazing job. The cut was just as I requested. Highly recommend!
Thank you!

My Pets Vet Wilderness Oaks has been amazing.  They were able to fix my dogs chronic UTI's (over 60 cases) where other vets could not. It's been life changing for her!  They have a super friendly staff, really affordable prices, and have amazing care.  Would highly recommend!
Very friendly staff and the Doctor made sure to explain things about our Dodger thankyou
The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and clearly cares about the animals they work with. My dog always comes back happy, well cared for, and excited to return.
Thank you!
Great processional, friendly & caring staff! Developed a plan for our dog with allergies & left feeling great about the appointment! Thank you!
Friendliest staff and doctor! My pup has zero fear of vet visits and loves getting hugs and treats during checkups
They missed a severe ear infection and tapeworms in my cat. $200 for a “clean bill of health” that was anything but. I recommend looking into other vets in the area if you care about your pets ❤️
Staff and Doctor,  very professional and friendly! Always give accurate info for all pets 🤗
Wonderful vet. And very nice and helpful staff. Took great care of my Labrador dog.

I’m impressed with the care that Dr. Larry Pearson has provided for my dog. She has suffered from skin allergies for the past 4 years and was prescribed medication over the years prior to visiting him at My Pet’s Vet in Wilderness Oaks. My experience with the medication was a quick temporary relief, refills were expensive, and I was concerned she was having frequent flare ups which were not food related. On my first visit with Dr. Pearson, he took the time to explain what was happening and options that would be best for my dog. I chose the injection that would help build her immunity to allergens. This option would be less costly and reduce flare ups as her body built her own immunity to the allergens requiring less treatment and visits to the vet. Her skin has improved, she’s not miserable, and her fur is growing back! This was the best option and I am grateful for Dr. Pearson’s expertise and pleasant experience. The staff have all been very nice and professional over the phone and in person. I highly recommend Dr. Pearson and his office staff! My travel is worth coming here!
Tatiana loved her energy really good employee giver erase

My Pet’s Place is a wonderful choice for my Walter. There is less chaos than other boarding options which makes him less anxious. They send daily photos & provide updates. Also, good to know, they offer military discount.

I spoke with Ashley over the phone currently and I had the most unprofessional, unpleasant conversation with her. She was speaking over me, interrupting me. I paid over $1,000+ for a surgery and this is how they treat their customers? I was upset and did speak to someone prior, granted YOU SHOULD NEVER TREAT A CUSTOMER LIKE THIS. Customers pay your pockets, without them you wouldn’t have a business. The reason I was upset? They charged my care-credit card without giving me a promotional rate. Ashley tried downplaying it saying they’re not aware of promotional rates, which is a lie because I worked front office with credit cards AND I am also personally a credit card specialist. They just charged it as a regular credit card. I need this fixed ASAP. I will be contacting the manager on Monday to hopefully fix this, if not I will have to reach out to the FTC, BBB and Media. Till then, my review of 1 star will remain.

Dr. Pearson is beyond Amazing. Extremely sweet, patient, caring and takes his time with your baby. The staff is amazing as well. Let’s just say that he’s the only Dr that isn’t able to listen to my dogs heart murmur. You know why? Because that’s how peaceful my dog feels when he’s there. Those words were said to us by a cardiologist. As prior to coming here a heart murmur was heard by another vet. Pretty amazing if I say so. We love Dr. Pearson and their staff. You feel loved and well taken cared of.

I love the way they take care of my furry baby. They take their time to make Sully comfortable and confident every time we go there.
Love the staff!! Thank you guys!
Thank you!

A few days ago, I took my dog in for his first visit at My Pet’s Vet due to allergies. The ladies at the front desk, as well as Dr. Pearson and Leslie, were so kind and patient with us! My dog is a big baby and a bit of a scaredy-cat, but Dr. Pearson and Leslie took the time to try to help him feel comfortable by getting down on the floor to pet and examine him. They even let me walk him to the back so that he could be weighed. I really appreciate their kindness and effort.

I also want to mention how efficient the visit was—we were seen right away. We checked in at the front desk, were promptly taken to a room, and quickly met with the vet assistant and veterinarian. They also took the time to go over different treatment options for my dog’s allergies, explaining the pros and cons of each along with the associated costs.
If you’re looking for a new vet, I definitely recommend checking them out!
Thank you!
Dr. Pearson is the best! Staff are also very loving and caring. Definitely recommend this place

I have been coming for a while and its always been ok but this visit was different. Megan greeted me the second i walked through the door. They immediately got us back in a room. The vet tech Lesley was super friendly and  helpful . She even agreed to help cut my dogs nails because he is scared and  aggressive and i cant do it alone  but she came through like a champ and showed no fear or concern other than helping get Rambos nails cut. Dr Pearson was great. It was our first time seeing him. He was by far the best vet i have dealt with ever. He was friendly and informative. This Staff is a winning team and i hope the owners of this place appreciate them. Would have given 100 stars if that was an option. Ps Im pretty hard to please 😂👍👍👍
I was very pleased with all staff and didnt have to wait long. Dr was very thorough and explained everything clearly. He cared for my dog and said not to hesitate to call.
The office is clean and well-organized. I really appreciated the cat-friendly exam room. Dr. Pearson is everything you could want in a veterinarian. His staff were also wonderful.
We love it here. We bring both of our little here. They care very much about you pets. I’ve never felt rushed out of an appointment.

I'm confident that my fur baby, Sasha will get the absolute best veterinary treatment. Dr. Pearson and the TOTAL team are OUTSTANDING. Sasha has regularly got nervous upon entering, but quickly settles down when she gets so much love and great care. My appreciation and thanks to the TOTAL team!!!

My Pet's Place is absolutely amazing! Our 2- year old mini poodle just loves it there and enjoys seeing and playing with his friends (human and canine 😄). We have been purchasing monthly or biweekly daycare stays for our pup for over a year and couldn't be happier. He normally goes daily while we're working and sometimes we may just drop him off for a few hours on a Saturday/Holiday while we run errands.

We love and trust the staff and this facility. Ariana, Celeste, Ali and Joselynn are incredible. We never have to worry about our baby when he is in their care. They are friendly, knowledgeable and very professional. I highly recommend this establishment for anyone looking for a great doggy daycare!

My Pet's Vet is also amazing. Dr. Pearson and the staff have always been friendly and super helpful.

Very good.  Saw our cat and diagnosed dirty ears (causing the cat to scratch itself).  Also did a nail clip on the spot saving us from having to go to the groomer.  Very nice and competent.  Also ver accessible.  Recommemded.
Very good experience, might say excellent experience better!

First and foremost the staff are wonderful. Front office Megan is just so wonderful and understanding. Vet tech is so calm and patient with my boys. Lastly, Dr Pearson, is excellent, I am so thankful he is my boys Vet. He takes his time and always makes sure my boys are well taken care of.
Thank you!

We needed boarding for both frenchies and they were able to accommodate us on short notice. The staff were very helpful and thoroughly explained the cost and service they provide for the duration of our pets' stay. Our pet were taken care of and they provided daily updates on our pets' well being and photos to show us how they were doing during playtime and also made new friends. I would recommend this place, just like it was recommended to us.
Our dog, Leo, loves My Pet's Vet.  Dr. Pearson and staff are top notch.  The service they provide is outstanding.  We would never consider going anywhere else.

Best Vet office I have ever been to--so friendly and really understanding of your situation..the dr. does whatever he can to help your pet and you, even financially--when I couldn't afford some of the tests needed, he made sure we still got what we needed and I will take all my pets here..
The surgery went well and all the staff took great care with Gizmo. Gizmo says meow.

I have been bringing my dogs here for over a year every time I have to go out of town. My dogs love being there... They are well treated and personnel are friendly and warm. They love pets and give me peace of mind while I am out of town.
My pet store works alongside these vets and they're the best ! Dr P, Dr. Schweers, Leslie, Hanna, and Megan are the best I've experienced and worked with !

Great experience. Had an emergency with my cat, and they were able to see me right away. The staff cares deeply and gave me helpful information to better my cats health. The price is also affordable and reasonable. Thank yall! ❤️

First time my 10 yr old cat was groomed at a facility, I used to do it myself. I am so grateful to have found My Pets Vet.  Outstanding care, customer service, friendly, knowledgeable, and so compassionate.   Thank you Tammy for grooming Oliver!!!! I am so happy definitely recommend this facility.  Blessings.
The staff was so kind and they were able fit in my sweet girl in while I was moving here from Florida. They even waived her 1st visit fee and gave her a delicious treat afterwards.
Great experience with the staff & visit.

I highly recommend My Pet's Vet Wilderness Oaks. Dr. Pearson is very professional and takes the time to explain both your pet's diagnosis and the recommended treatment. The staff are all professional and personable.

Very nice place, we got all 3 of our kitties on their premium plan for regular care.  Vet is patient and takes his time to explain things, which is nice.  Prices are very reasonable too, especially for the level of care provided. Deducting one star because we received 3 different prices on the premium plan.  When we went in, the plan increased $10 a month because apparently they quoted us for kittens (they never asked to clarify on the phone), and instead of one service charge and the other two being comped, we had to pay for two amd the third was comped.  The third price was what we actually got, which was still the higher monthly payment and split the difference on the service charges (paid one and a half).  We really liked the vet and the staff, but we really don't like being quoted lower prices only for the price to increase once you're there on the day of your appointment.  Having said all that, still giving 4 stars because, plan pricing issues aside, they are a great practice and we are glad to have them so close to home

Wonderful first experience at My Pets Vet Animal Hospital today. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed and greeted by the front staff. I had called in the morning of and was able to secure a last-minute office visit for my female senior dog. I was in desperate need of her allergy medication and was unable to be seen by her usual veterinary doctor due to their limited scheduling. Dr. Pearson was extremely thorough with my pets health history, including her diet. I was impressed by Dr. Pearson's concerns as well as alternatives for treatment options for her skin allergies. I am definitely returning and switching over from her usual veterinary doctor. Office was clean, location was perfect, and highly professional staff. His prices were also affordable, which was a huge plus.
Great customer  service at a fair price
Dr Pearson is wonderful. He and his team take great care of our corgis
Prices are reasonable and staff is super friendly and knowledgable!

Fist visit today and I was really happy! Dr. Pearson is so sweet and dedicated the time for my dog and answered all my questions. He suggested treatment and did not pushed into any decision plus understand how expensive certain decisions can be! First visit was complimentary and only had to paid for meds and I was amazed on not being ripped in price. Definitely going back and recommend 100%

The staff and the veterinarian here are very nice and you don’t feel rushed. I was going to the VCA on Thousand Oaks for many years, the prices for the visits were never the same. The cost of the medication’s changed all the time.

I have had some really bad experiences with Vets in the past, so I’m alway a bit hesitant to go to these places. However they are necessary if you have a pet.
The staff was friendly and helpful the Dr. was very knowledgeable, friendly and genuinely cared about our dogs. Didn’t try to sell us something we didn’t need. He even answered our questions about our other pets.
I will be going back. I believe we finally found a good care provider for our dogs.
When your pet is sick, you want someone who will tell you what the best options are for your pet—not someone who preys on your emotions or just wants your money. …

I was very excited to be a client at this facility. The name drew me and the website made me seem that these people genuinely care for my pet. It is also convenient located for those that live around Stone Oak. However, when I called to …
Friendly staff!
Wonderful job cutting my dogs hair. He looks wonderful. Awsome dog groomer
